text.en: This Order may be cited as the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Trust (Amendment) (No. 3) Order, 2024 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 13th September 2016.

the Supplemental Contributory Pensions Trust Order, 2009, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended, in subsection (1), by deleting the definition of "derivative SCP benefit". of section 23
of the principal Order is repealed. of section 39

of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (2) - (a} by deleting paragraph (eJ; (bJ in paragraph (fJ, by deleting ", survivorship benefit and derivative SCP benefit" and by substituting "and survivorship benefit" therefor. Made this 11th. day of Rejab, 1445 Hijriah corresponding to the 23rd. day of January, 2024 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, DARUSSALAM.
